selected_work: R83 extend texture resource exactness/descriptor observation from stages 0/1 to all eight D3D9 texture stages.
summary: Extended passive DX11 texture-resource observation and exactness across D3D9 stages 0..7. Each stage now records bound/observed resource type, pool, usage and format. Resource behavior and format exactness are evaluated per bound stage and represented by present/exact masks. R82 fixed-function readiness now requires a bound exact resource only for a supported stage whose color/alpha operation actually selects D3DTA_TEXTURE; stage index alone is no longer a blocker. Per-stage texture evidence and bound/exact/pending counters were added. No shader generation or native draw activation was enabled.
evidence: CONVERSION-DX11-00022 identified texture resource exactness beyond stages 0/1 as the direct prerequisite to safely widen F20 fixed-function readiness.
R83 keeps all existing resource behavior, mutation telemetry and MANAGED CPU-shadow requirements fail-closed while applying them to all eight bound texture stages.

changes.result: Extended fixed-function readiness API with texture resource present/exact masks.
Replaced blanket stage>=2 rejection with per-stage D3DTA_TEXTURE dependency on bound exact resource masks.

Added eight-stage TextureStageResourceState observation, per-stage behavior/format exactness, present/exact masks, texture resource counters and per-signature stage logs; readiness is computed after resource exactness.
Added R83 summary/signature compatibility, textureStageResource counters and per-stage texture resource parsing.
Added R83 regression fixture proving stage 7 resource evidence parsing and stage>=2 resource-ready fixed-function evidence.
Added structural guards for eight-stage texture resource state, resource masks/counters and analyzer evidence.

activation_gate.reason: R83 extends resource exactness/readiness evidence only. It emits no fixed-function shader; programmable F21 translation, live D3D11 resource mirror ownership and exact-build Quest3/VDXR parity remain prerequisites.

next_action: Keep NativeDrawPathActivationAllowed=false and shaderTranslationExact=false. In the next bounded DX11 task, prototype fixed-function shader generation that consumes only R82/R83-ready states, without mixing in F21 programmable shader translation. Any generated shader path must remain non-routing/diagnostic until semantic validation and exact-build Quest3/VDXR parity are proven.
